title: O1 (Outdoor 1)
description: An outdoor scenario of two streets and one intersection
details: 18 base stations and more than a million candidate users!
Datasets are available at operating frequencies 3.4 GHz, 3.5 GHz, 28 GHz, and 60 GHz

keyComponents.name: Users
keyComponents.description:
1. Three uniform x-y user grids (UGs): UG1, UG2, and UG3.
  2. Total number of users = 1,184,923 users
  3. The first user in every user grid is always the user with the lowest (x,y) coordinate

  14. Second user grid (UG2)

  16. Accessed from Row 2752 to Row 3852 (1101 rows in total)
  17. 181 users per row (181 users with the same y coordinate)
  18. 20 cm spacing between adjacent users
  19. Number of users in UG2 = 199,281 users
  20. Third user grid (UG3)
  21. Distributed on the second cross street (the vertical street on the left side of Figure 2)
  22. Accessed from Row 3853 to Row 5203 (1351 rows in total)
  23. 361 users per row (361 users with the same y coordinate)
  24. 10 cm spacing between adjacent users
  25. Number of users in UG3 = 487,711 users

keyComponents.name: Site Plan
keyComponents.description:
1. The main street (the horizontal one) is 600 m long and 40 m wide
  2. The cross street (the vertical one) is 440 m long and 40 m wide
  3. The two streets have buildings on both sides
  4. The height of every building is written on it in Figure 1
  5. Along the main street, all the buildings have bases of the same dimensions, 30 m x 60 m
  6. In the second street, the buildings have bases of 60 m x 60 m
  7. As for the propagation model, each channel path can undergo a maximum of 4 reflections before reaching the receiver.

title: O1 Blockage (Outdoor 1 Blockage)

title: Dynamic Doppler (DD1)
description: A dynamic outdoor scenario of three streets and two intersections
details: The main horizontal street has 4 lanes (2 in each direction) of mobile vehicles
The vehicles change their positions with every scene out of 2000 captured scenes!
Four static BS are deployed along the main horizontal street
Each UE antenna is attached to the top of each moving vehicle!
The Doppler velocity is available for all BS-BS and BS-UE channels!
The scenes are continuously sampled from the scenario with 100 ms sampling interval
Datasets are available at operating frequencies 28 GHz
